sources_read.section: the primitives already animate on data-state
jsdom + the canvas stub; no matchMedia

scope: Add motion behind one shared seam and animate five surfaces, transform-only. Out of scope: route transitions, scroll reveals, layout animation, and anything on a Konva canvas.

acceptance_criteria.text: Components import the seam, not motion/react; reduced motion is honoured centrally.
The five surfaces animate; each is visible at every moment (no opacity-from-0).
verify green with no test change beyond the matchMedia stub.
The never-hide constraint is written down with the observation that proved it.

open_questions: Whether to add page (route) transitions later is a product call; the workspace is a single long-lived route, so an entrance is the meaningful moment today.
risks: jsdom has no matchMedia: Motion asks for prefers-reduced-motion, so the setup file now provides the smallest stand-in.
Opacity-from-0 would hide a background tab (rAF paused); the variants are transform-only for exactly that reason.
Motion must not touch the canvases; it is DOM-only and the Konva leaves are unchanged.
